description:
Meet the all-new 2025 EVRYjourney 1000W Mid Drive Electric Rickshaw — a groundbreaking step forward in adaptive mobility transportation for families, seniors, and riders with disabilities. Engineered for comfort, inclusion, and stability, this mobility-focused electric rickshaw combines powerful performance with thoughtful design to make every journey safe, fun, and worry-free.

The newly PATENT PENDING hitch system transforms the Rickshaw into an incredibly versatile adaptive mobility vehicle. Whether you need extra room for family members, children with autism, or grandparents needing stable support, the hitch lets you easily attach an additional row of seats or a storage trailer. Families can quickly switch between passenger mode and cargo mode — perfect for trips to the park, the beach, appointments, or community outings.

The 1000W mid-drive motor delivers smooth, reliable torque for carrying passengers and equipment over inclines and uneven terrain, ensuring confidence on every ride. Paired with hydraulic disc brakes, this rickshaw combines powerful acceleration with dependable stopping power for a safe, controlled experience — ideal for riders supporting individuals with limited mobility or sensory sensitivities.

Three Hydraulic Disc Brakes:

One in the front, two in the rear — providing improved stopping control and safety, especially when carrying family members or riders with mobility challenges.

Rear Hitch for Adaptive Use:

The rear hitch system allows for quick attachment of extra seating or a cargo basket. Ideal for families with children who need sensory-safe space or seniors requiring adaptive transportation.

Extra Seat and Trailer Sold Separately:

Expand your accessibility options. Add an extra row of seating for kids, caregivers, or seniors, or attach a cargo trailer to hold personal equipment, groceries, or medical supplies.

1000W Power with Pedal Assist or Full Electric Mode:

Enjoy accessible electric support — choose pedal assist for exercise or full electric mode for effortless travel, making it easier for riders with strength or endurance limitations.

Stable, Comfortable Ride:

Featuring 20” rear wheels and a 24” front wheel with wide 4-inch tires that deliver a cushioned, stable ride — perfect for riders needing extra sensory comfort or balance support.

Strong Passenger Support:

Under-seat reinforcements ensure a 300 lb. bench capacity, offering durable and dependable support for families and mobility users.

Enhanced Visibility:

Built-in mirrors maximize safety and awareness for riders and caregivers when navigating communities or urban routes.

Battery Compliant to UL 2271 Safety Standard (Tested by ACT Labs)
